runs.description: On a kitten clip, the kitten walks past, Motion crosses its line and the alert arrives.
longDescription: The kitten faces the camera on a grey carpet, then gets up and walks past.
Motion crosses its line and a movement alert arrives.
The watch scrolls to Alerts and holds the movement alert and its picture in view.

runs.description: The kitten clip's movement and sound alerts, and the picture one of them kept.
longDescription: 0–2 seconds. Since you last looked shows movement and sound alerts from the kitten clip.
2–7 seconds. The movement alert opens its kept picture of the kitten with its face in view.

runs.description: The kitten clip compared with a photo from another day, and a possible sighting.
longDescription: 0–2 seconds. Lost and Found holds Toffee’s one saved photo, a kitten lying on a beige carpet.
2–5 seconds. The watch compares the kitten clip, on a grey carpet, with that photo twice a second.
5–9 seconds. A possible sighting asks "Could this be Toffee?" with the camera’s picture beside the saved photo, to check by eye.
